title: 第13章 谁懂啊回家被人抡起来砸还被人用雷劈第14章 师兄帮你把这烂桃花给斩了
content_zh:
任家书房。
坐在书桌前翻看着账本的任发，疲惫地打了个哈欠。
这段时间，忙着给自己的老爹起棺迁坟，都没来得及照顾生意，查看账本。
幸好，终于成功把老爹重新安葬了，今晚可以安心地查看下账本了。
咚！咚！咚！
沉重的脚步声传来，把正在聚精会神盘算账本的任发惊醒。
听到动静的任发，不满地骂道：“大晚上的，是谁在走动，也不注意点声响！”
起身来到窗前的任发，刚想打开窗户看看是谁在制造噪音扰人。却发现窗前站着一道人影，定睛一看，那狰狞的面孔，熟悉的寿衣，关爱的眼神，嘴巴里还露出的长长的，带着鲜血的獠牙，不正是自己的好大爹——任威勇吗！
“啊！爹！你怎么会在这……你不是被埋看吗？你不要过来啊！！”
任发认清人影后，往后一倒，发出了一声步惊云式的惊叫！、
“吼哦！吼！”
任威勇看见自己好大儿的窘状，兴奋地嚎叫一声，向前一跳，双手用力往前一插。
“吼啊！吼！”
兴奋的嚎叫变立马成了痛苦的叫声，只见两道金光闪过，一道将任老太爷击飞，使其摔到了院子里；另一道则化为一层薄如蝉翼的金光，将任发牢牢地护住。正是林道然给的符箓——驱邪符和金光符。
其实任老太爷一来到任家，林道然就发觉了，但是他不确定任老太爷先攻击的是谁，于是就先到了任婷婷的房间，将任婷婷一起带到了书房。
书房里，林道然看见任发安全无事，松了口气，然后对书房喘着粗气的任发说道：“任伯伯，别怕，让我来对付他，你先派人去义庄通知我师父，让他带齐法器过来！”
说完从窗户纵身一跃，来到了院子里，看着已经站直的任老太爷，
只见任老太爷身穿清朝官服，身上长满了黑色的毛发，指甲长约十来公分，散发着幽幽的蓝光，嘴上长长的獠牙还带着血丝，看来是一只已经吸食了人血的黑僵了！
“道然哥，你要小心啊！要是打不过，我们就先跑，等师父过来收拾他！”
身处二楼书房的任婷婷，从窗户里伸出脑袋，朝着林道然喊道。

“放心吧，婷婷，你就等着看我怎么大发神威将你爷爷拿下！“
任老太爷看起来实在是太凶了，受了银境驱邪符一击，也仅仅是身上焦黑了少许，并没有收到实质性的伤害！
“你相信光吗？“
林道然随口向任老太爷问了一句，就往自己身上贴了两张金光符，立马一层厚如纸片的金光笼罩在他身上，使他成为了一个金光闪闪的小金人。然后就朝着僵尸冲了过去。
书房里，已经吩咐完下人去找九叔的任发和任婷婷，猫在窗口目瞪口呆地看着院子里，浑身金光笼罩，犹如神将降临的林道然。
林道然竟然能和力大无穷，刀枪不入的恐怖僵尸肉搏，而且还能将其狠狠地压制着！
只见林道然闪着金光，一脚就能将僵尸踹飞几米远，几拳就能将僵尸的胸口打得凹陷进去！
“哇！道然哥，加油，你好厉害啊！”
看着林道然大发神威的任婷婷，情不自禁地喊了声。
听到任婷婷呼喊声，任老太爷猛地抬头一看，是自己的好大儿和可爱的小孙女。立马放弃和眼前硬得跟钢铁一样的林道然肉搏了，纵身一跳。
“道然哥，救命啊！“
看着往自己这边跳来的爷爷！任婷婷吓得脸都白了，连连后退。口中还不停喊着。
“小老弟！在我面前还想伤人，你是多不把我看在眼里啊！”
林道然怒吼一声，伸手扯住僵尸的脚，在天上甩了几圈大风车后，又如绿巨人打诡计之神一样，在院子里玩起了砸坑游戏。
啪！左一坑。
啪！右一坑。
……
足足砸了十几个坑后，林道然将手中的僵尸甩出，飞翔途中还撞断了一根石柱子。
content_en:
Ren's study room.
Ren Fa, who was sitting at the desk and looking through his account books, yawned tiredly.
During this period of time, I was busy lifting the coffin and moving the grave of my father, and I didn't have time to take care of the business or check the accounts.
Fortunately, I finally succeeded in reburying my father, and I can check the account books with peace of mind tonight.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
The sound of heavy footsteps woke up Ren Fa who was concentrating on calculating the ledger.
Ren Fa, who heard the noise, cursed dissatisfiedly: "Who is walking around at night and not paying attention to the sound!"
Ren Fa got up and came to the window. He was about to open the window to see who was making the noise. However, he found a figure standing in front of the window. When he took a closer look, he saw that the ferocious face, the familiar shroud, the caring eyes, and the long, bloody fangs exposed in his mouth were none other than his good father--Ren Weiyong!
"Ah! Dad! Why are you here...aren't you being buried? Don't come over!!"
After Ren Fa recognized the figure, he fell back and let out a Bu Jingyun-style scream! ,
"Hoo! Hoo!"
Seeing the embarrassment of his big boy, Ren Weiyong howled excitedly, jumped forward, and thrust forward with both hands.
"Roar! Roar!"
The excited howl immediately turned into a cry of pain, and two golden lights flashed by. One of them knocked Old Mrs. Ren away and made him fall into the yard; the other turned into a layer of golden light as thin as cicada wings, firmly protecting Ren Fa. It was the talismans given by Lin Daoran - the exorcism talisman and the golden light talisman.
In fact, Lin Daoran noticed as soon as Mrs. Ren came to Ren's house, but he was not sure who Mrs. Ren attacked first, so he went to Ren Tingting's room first and took Ren Tingting to the study together.
In the study, Lin Daoran breathed a sigh of relief when he saw that Ren Fa was safe, and then said to Ren Fa who was breathing heavily in the study: "Uncle Ren, don't be afraid, let me deal with him. You first send someone to Yizhuang to inform my master and ask him to bring all the magic weapons!"
After saying that, he jumped from the window and came to the yard. He looked at Mr. Ren who had stood up straight.
I saw Mrs. Ren wearing the official uniform of the Qing Dynasty. His body was covered with black hair. His nails were about ten centimeters long and emitted a faint blue light. The long fangs on his mouth were still bloodshot. It seemed that he was a black zombie that had sucked human blood!
"Brother Daoran, you have to be careful! If we can't beat him, we'll run away first and wait for the master to come and deal with him!"
Ren Tingting, who was in the study room on the second floor, stuck her head out of the window and shouted towards Lin Daoran.
"Don't worry, Tingting, just wait and see how I can use my power to take down your grandfather!"
Old Master Ren looked too fierce. He was hit by the Silver Realm Exorcist Talisman, but his body was only slightly scorched, and he did not receive any substantial damage!
"Do you believe in the light?"
Lin Daoran casually asked Mr. Ren, and then put two golden talismans on himself. A layer of golden light as thick as a piece of paper immediately enveloped him, turning him into a glittering little golden man. Then he rushed towards the zombies.
In the study, Ren Fa and Ren Tingting had already ordered their servants to go find Uncle Jiu. The cat stared at the yard in amazement from the window, shrouded in golden light, like Lin Daoran who was about to descend.
Lin Daoran was actually able to fight hand-to-hand with a terrifying zombie that was extremely powerful and invulnerable, and was able to suppress it severely!
I saw Lin Daoran shining with golden light. He could kick the zombie several meters away with one kick, and dent the zombie's chest with a few punches!
"Wow! Brother Daoran, come on, you are so awesome!"
Ren Tingting, who saw Lin Daoran showing off his power, couldn't help shouting.
Hearing Ren Tingting's shouts, Mrs. Ren suddenly looked up and saw that it was his eldest son and his lovely little granddaughter. He immediately gave up fighting with Lin Daoran, who was as hard as steel in front of him, and jumped up.
"Brother Daoran, help!"
Look at grandpa jumping towards him! Ren TingTing was so frightened that her face turned pale and she backed away repeatedly. He kept shouting.
"Little brother! You still want to hurt people in front of me, how can you not take me seriously!"
Lin Daoran roared angrily, stretched out his hand to grab the zombie's feet, and after swinging the zombie in the sky a few times, he played a pit-breaking game in the yard like the Hulk playing the God of Trick.
Snap! Pit to the left.
Snap! A pit on the right.
…
After smashing a dozen holes, Lin Daoran threw the zombie out of his hand, breaking a stone pillar while flying.
